Five pieces of cassava or pineapple sit next to a small portion of scrambled eggs on a square plate about 26 cm across.

The yellow chunks look fibrous and fried, so they are likely fried cassava (yuca) or plantain. Each piece is about 4×2.5×2 cm, roughly 20 g, so the five pieces total about 100 g. Fried cassava runs about 250 kcal per 100 g, giving roughly 250 kcal.

The scrambled egg patch is about 12×10 cm and thin, which suggests 2 eggs, about 100 g. With some cooking fat, that is roughly 170–200 kcal.

That puts the total at about 200 g and 430 kcal.
